source.note: Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0 `chairModernCushion` (GLB), not the plan's `chairDesk` (an office swivel chair with armrests and a five-star base, wrong for a classroom). Of the kit's chairs (chair, chairCushion, chairRounded: all-wood slat backs; chairModernFrameCushion: cantilever tube frame with no backrest; chairDesk: office chair) this is the one with a school chair's build: four straight legs and a frame of one material (`metal`, drawn as pale painted metal), with the seat and the backrest panel's front in another (`carpetBlue`, recoloured as wood). At 0.85 m to the back top the seat is 0.45 m, real school-chair size; the kit's own scale (desk-teacher at 0.74 m) would make it 0.89 m, so the two sit together within 4 %. Front (seat edge) faces +Z. Static, no clips.
